articles.description: Binance has activated its tokenized-equity layer, converting live stock positions on its brokerage platform into BNB Chain tokens tradable around the clock. The first five bStocks include Nvidia, Tesla, Circle, Micron, and Sandisk.
articles.title: Binance Converts Stock Holdings Into On-Chain Tokens With bStocks Launch

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong disclosed three platform-scale metrics on Thursday: approximately $1 trillion in annual stablecoin movement, $20 billion in USDC held on platform, and more than 160 million autonomous transactions via the x402 agentic payments protocol in the last year.
articles.title: Brian Armstrong Says Coinbase Processes $1T in Stablecoin Payments Annually

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Citigroup is making tokenized interests in private companies available to wealth-management and institutional clients on SIX Digital Exchange, the Wall Street Journal reported. The bank has already completed its first transaction and is in talks with additional private firms.
articles.title: Citi Rolls Out Tokenized Private-Company Shares for Wealth and Institutional Clients

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Delaware and New Jersey each advanced bills this week to ban cryptocurrency ATMs statewide, citing over $400 million in annual nationwide fraud losses and a scam pattern that disproportionately targets older residents.
articles.title: Delaware and New Jersey Move to Ban Crypto ATMs Over Fraud Concerns

articles.title: Wall Street Piles Into Digital Asset as Canton Network Draws $355M Round Led by a16z

The 2% share of TradFi-referenced perpetuals volume positions the June 1 launch as a distribution play for underserved
articles.title: Binance Stock Trading Draws 84% of First-Week Volume From Emerging Markets

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Kalshi opened more than 150 insider-trading investigations in the first quarter of 2026, blocked over 100 potential insider trades, and referred at least 20 cases to law enforcement. The CFTC-regulated prediction market paired the numbers Tuesday with a new risk-scoring framework,
articles.title: Kalshi Reports 150+ Insider-Trading Investigations in Q1, Rolls Out Employer Checks for High-Risk Markets

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Federal prosecutors have subpoenaed JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo, examining whether banks unlawfully terminated customer accounts for political reasons. The probe directly validates the crypto industry's Operation Chokepoint 2.0 grievances.
articles.title: DOJ Opens Debanking Probe Into JPMorgan, Bank of America and Wells Fargo

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: An NFT creator published a thread claiming to trace large ADA flows to IOG-linked stake pool pledges from the 2021 bull market. Cardano's founder has made no public statement in response to the new analysis. ADA is down 42% over the past 30 days.
articles.title: On-Chain Tracking Revives Allegations That Hoskinson Sold 1.5B ADA in the 2021 Rally

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Robinhood Securities has received approval to serve as an IPO underwriter, CEO Vlad Tenev announced Tuesday, positioning the zero-commission broker to compete directly with Wall Street banks on the mega-IPO pipeline.
articles.title: Robinhood Securities Gains IPO Underwriter Status, CEO Tenev Targets Retail Allocation

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: An attacker exploited Token of Power's Aragon DAO on Tuesday to mint 10 billion TOP tokens via a malicious governance proposal, then swapped the supply for 944.2 WETH worth roughly $1.58 million.
articles.title: Attacker Mints 10 Billion TOP Tokens Through Governance Takeover, Drains $1.58M from Balancer Pool

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Raydium core contributor Infra confirmed Wednesday that an attacker drained ~$1.34M from the legacy AMM V3 program, a contract phased out in 2021. Current users were unaffected, the treasury will cover full compensation, and the root cause was a self-contained LP-mint validation flaw. PeckShield
articles.title: Raydium Confirms $1.34M Drain on Deprecated AMM V3, Pledges Treasury Compensation

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: ZK blockchain project Hyli is shutting down after two years, with the team citing weak demand for zero-knowledge technology. The closure comes the same day Botanix wound down its Bitcoin Layer 2.
articles.title: Hyli Winds Down Two-Year ZK Blockchain Project, Citing Lack of ZK Traction
